# COPILOT_PYTHON_FILE_STRUCTURE.md

# Standard Python File Structure for Copilot-Generated Code

All Python scripts, modules, and libraries generated by Copilot must follow this
deterministic, audit-friendly structure. This ensures clarity, maintainability,
and predictable navigation for future maintainers.

The structure below must appear in this exact order unless explicitly overridden.

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Imports
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# - Standard library imports first
# - Third-party imports second
# - Local application imports last
# - No unused imports
# - Group logically, alphabetize when appropriate

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Configuration / Constants
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# - Centralize all constants, environment variable lookups,
#   default paths, and configuration values.
# - Avoid scattering configuration throughout the file.

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Functions / Classes
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# - Pure functions preferred where possible.
# - Classes only when stateful behavior is required.
# - Each function should have a docstring describing:
#       * Purpose
#       * Inputs
#       * Outputs
#       * Side effects
#       * Exceptions raised

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Main Entrypoint
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# - Guarded by: if __name__ == "__main__":
# - Parse CLI arguments here (if applicable).
# - Call top-level orchestration functions.
# - Avoid placing business logic directly in the entrypoint.

# End of file
